decisions.reason: This product is highly related to the firm's established aviation-security and compliance capabilities, and its proven use by the UK Home Office and links to more than 30 APIS schemes give strong evidence the firm can exploit and further improve it.

Although demand may be less certain than for core security products, the API builds on the firm's existing travel-compliance knowledge and customer base, so its absorptive capacity and integration advantages still support retaining it.

Document verification is close to the firm's core operational know-how and complements its integrated airport and border-security services, making it a product the firm is well placed to learn from and commercialise further.
